name: The Old Forge
address: The Old Forge, Ballyduff, Camolin, Co. Wexford
bedsNote: Main bedroom with en suite on the ground floor; bedroom 2 doubles as the landing
tagline: A stone-and-timber cottage on 0.6 acres in rural north Wexford, 4 km from Camolin and about 15 minutes from Gorey and its Dublin train.

pros.detail: The main bedroom (4.1 × 4.9 m, dual aspect, door to the garden) and its en suite are on the ground floor, plus a separate ground-floor bathroom.
Ballyduff NS, 64 pupils (multi-grade classes); Camolin NS (4.3 km) is the fallback. Gorey Community School is the secondary, ~14 km.

pros.text: Private site already set up for dogs
pros.detail: 0.6 acres, secluded and tree-lined, with a dog pen and timber shed.
Exposed stone, timber floors, feature fireplace and a freestanding stove; presented as move-in ready.
A characterful cottage 20 minutes from the Wexford coast lets well in summer.
Third-party report shows full fibre at the address; confirm with the agent.

cons.detail: Above the 100 m² floor, but Bedroom 2 is the landing; a third proper bedroom or a kitchen-living extension is a rough €80–120k.
Enough for a fenced run, but short of the 1-acre ideal for two vizslas.
Expensive to run. A heat pump and insulation is a rough €30–50k before grants.
Ballyduff is a crossroads with a school; Camolin's shop is 4 km and everything else is a drive.
Wexford General is the nearest 24-hour emergency department. See the 3 a.m. trip below.

cons.text: Train is a drive and infrequent
cons.detail: Gorey station about 15 minutes away; about 5 direct trains a day, fastest 1h43 to Connolly.
Private well and septic tank; the area is EPA high-radon, so test before buying (remediation a rough €800–2,000).
Kitchen 2.7 × 2.1 m, sitting room 2.5 × 3.8 m; family life needs a new kitchen-living extension, not just more bedrooms.

questions: Has the house been tested for radon?

ai.why: Rural, dog-ready, cheap, with a downstairs suite. Compact at 115 m² with a tiny kitchen and a landing bedroom.

internet.detail: Fibre likely; BuyerIQ's address report lists 'full fibre' at Y21 A8X6, consistent with NBI's rural rollout in north Wexford, though the listing itself doesn't mention broadband.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: The main bedroom, with an en-suite, is on the ground floor.
